senses.gloss:
तैतिल m. (-लः) A rhinoceros.
 n. (-लं) One of the astronomical periods
called Karanas.
 E. अण् added to तितिल.

तैत्तिर m. (-रः) A francoline partridge.
 n. (-रं) A flock of partridges. E.
तित्तिर, and अण् affix of aggregation or pleonastic.

तैत्तिरीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Relating to the Tittiri portion of the Vedas,
as a student, a text, teacher, section of, &c.
 E. तित्तिरि the Yajur
Veda so called, and छ affix; or तित्तिरि a partridge, affix as before;
the texts of this Veda being disgorged by YAJNYAWALKYA in a
tangible form, and picked up by the rest of VAISAMPAYANA'S dis-
ciples, who, for the purpose, assumed the shape of partridges.
तित्तिरिणा प्रोक्तमधीयते छण् ।

तैत्तिरीयक m. (-कः) A follower of the Tittiri branch of the Vedas. E.
कन् added to the preceding; also इन् being added तैत्तिरीयिन्, &c.
